body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Top broadcasters and technology blogs are gearing up to cover the new technology products for work, home and play that industry leaders, innovators, startups and upstarts will introduce at ShowStoppers, the press-only showcase event scheduled for 6 Jan. 2011 in Las Vegas.

ShowStoppers @ CES 2011 reserves a record 13 studio stages for global TV news networks CNN and ITN; world-class tech blogs Butterscotch, Slashgear, Techcrunch and Techweb; radio and web newscasters CBS Radio with Larry Magid, Computer America with Craig Crossman, Into Tomorrow with Dave Graveline, AppMinute.com with Sam Levin, Computer Outlook Radio with John Iasulo, and Tech Talk with Craig Peterson; and web broadcaster BNETtv.com.
More than 1,000 journalists, analysts and bloggers are already registered to attend the four-hour, invitation-only event.

The 100 exhibiting companies include, among others, Boxee, Casio, Electronic Arts, General Motors, Hewlett Packard, Intel, Iomega, Lexmark, Logitech, Novatel Wireless, Polaroid, Qualcomm, Real Networks, Skype and Trend Micro.
Special newsbeat areas include gaming, startups, mobile apps, healthcare, audio/video, computers and tablets, digital cameras, printers, software, and iTech.

One hour before the doors to the press event open, ShowStoppers convenes the IFA 2011 preview press conference; ShowStoppers partners with Messe Berlin and gfu to produce the official press event at IFA, the global tradeshow for consumer electronics and home appliances that takes place each September in Berlin.
ShowStoppers @ CES 2011 kicks off a year-long series of press events that includes:
ShowStoppers @ Mobile World Congress, 13 Feb. 2011, Barcelona, Spain.
ShowStoppers @ CTIA Wireless, 22 Mar. 2011, Orlando, Florida.
The IFA Global Press Conference, 16 April 2011, Alicante, Spain.
ShowStoppers for the Digital Holidays, 13 Sept. 2011, New York City.
ShowStoppers for the Mobile Holidays, October 2011, San Diego.

Now in its 18th year, ShowStoppers, http://www.showstoppers.com, is the global leader in producing press and business events. Each event organizes product introductions, sneak previews and demonstrations for hundreds of selected journalists, bloggers, industry and financial analysts, venture capitalists and business executives. Industry leaders, innovators, startups and upstart companies exhibit during the year at ShowStoppers events to help generate news coverage and product reviews, make new connections, promote brand, and open new markets.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
